C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

There were no Discussion Items.

D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Recreation and Community Services Director, gave an update regarding the Vaccine
Clinic.

Councilmember Maravilla thanked Staff and made comments regarding the Vaccine Clinic.

Mayor Roa thanked staff and made comments regarding the Vaccine Clinic.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

Councilmember Maravilla gave an update regarding the Graduation Banners.

Steve Gomez, Recreation and Community Services Director, gave an update regarding the Graduation
Banners.

Mayor Roa made comments regarding the Graduation Banners.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Linda Hollinsworth, Interim City Manager, thanked staff and made comments about the new Agenda
Management System.

Mayor Roa made comments about the Agenda Management System.

Steve Gomez, Recreation and Community Services Director, made comments regarding the Food
Drive at the Gardens Casino.

Councilmember Maravilla made comments about a flyer for the vaccination clinic and the Pacific
Gardens Medical Center and their services.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney reports.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Alvarado made comments about the Food Giveaway at the Gardens Casino and
encouraged the residents to participate.

Councilmember Farfan made comments regarding the Easter Egg Giveaway, Vaccination Clinic, and
thanked staff.

Steve Gomez, Recreation and Community Services Director, gave an update for the Curative
Vaccination Clinic.

Mayor Roa recongized staff and residents regarding the vaccine.
